scoring.cer: Levenshtein distance between the manually transcribed rendered text for a target region and the target, divided by the target length. Missing text counts as full length (CER=1 for that region, plus any extra characters in the distance). For multi-region prompts, CER is averaged over regions.
scoring.exact_match: 1 only if every target string for the prompt is reproduced exactly, character for character including case, digits and punctuation, and is legible. Otherwise 0.
scoring.spatial: Spatial-layout prompts only. 1 = all requested placements correct; 0.5 = at least one placement correct but another wrong or missing; 0 = no requested placement correct (including missing text). Placement is judged from the image, not from the prompt.
scoring.visual_quality: 1-5, judged separately from spelling. 5 = clean, coherent, well composed, text well integrated; 4 = good with minor artefacts; 3 = acceptable, noticeable flaws; 2 = poor, distracting artefacts or weak composition; 1 = incoherent or broken. Spelling errors do NOT lower this score by themselves; only legibility/integration artefacts do.

seed_policy: Fixed seed 42 requested for every generation (Space may still vary with queue/GPU nondeterminism; this is recorded, not hidden). One image per prompt per model, no cherry-picking, no regeneration of failures except for a failed HTTP/queue call (in which case the retry is logged).
